Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Wenia Falar: 28-year-old man, 160 cm (short), ordinary lean-to-average construction without visible definition, skin value band-2-light. Face: heart-shaped face; close-set eyes and a high arched brow; broad low bridge, full lips; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: sculpted edge pattern. Wardrobe: apron-workwear-layers, specifically a work shirt, asymmetrical apron layers, reinforced trousers, and sturdy shoes; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette indigo-sand. Visible personal details: a shaped cloth clasp; a hand-painted hem mark; two plain rings. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a bone-free wooden comb only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
